Todd Snyder.name: Todd Snyder
Todd Snyder.why: American menswear that names its Italian suppliers — the specific mill is printed on every product page — and a full own-label shoe program beside a curated wall of Alden, Paraboot, and Rubinacci.
Todd Snyder.origin: Todd Snyder, NYC, 2011 — ex-J.Crew menswear head with a Savile Row apprenticeship behind him.
Todd Snyder.opview: Positions itself as new American classics with the mills named.

onething.n: Works, but why is this THE ITEM

notes.ital: All the fabrics are Italian and the tailoring is made in Italy and Portugal — Tollegno cloth named on the product pages, a Pitti Uomo runway show, and Armani cited as the formative influence. Snyder learned to tailor in Des Moines and went to Italy for the cloth. Raised from 3 on 2026-08-09: the rubric says passport is not required, and this is an American brand with Italian mills, Italian make and Italian design language.
notes.golf: TS x FootJoy Premiere Series — a real golf-shoe line with the game's premier maker
notes.cotton: 54% of the clothing range, and 227 of those styles are 100% cotton — oxfords, selvedge denim, chinos, tees. Read across all 1,296 clothing products
notes.tech: almost none: 3% of the range is synthetic, spandex appears in 12% of styles at 1–3% for comfort rather than performance, and there is no house-named or licensed technology anywhere. Water resistance is claimed on eight styles
notes.craft: its fabric claim is provenance rather than technology. 321 styles state where the cloth comes from — Italy 195, Portugal 67, Japan 22 — concentrated in tailoring, with 33 of 39 sport coats Italian. Named mills are all third parties: Thomas Mason, Vitale Barberis Canonico, Baird McNutt, Albini, Kuroki

Todd Snyder.cities: ~15 stores — NYC, Boston, Chicago, DC & more · Nordstrom

Rag & Bone.name: Rag & Bone
Rag & Bone.why: New York denim-and-tailoring hybrid with British bones.
Rag & Bone.origin: Marcus Wainwright and David Neville, NYC, 2002 — Brits with no fashion training, first jeans made in a Kentucky factory.
Rag & Bone.opview: “Irreverent but respectful” — British bones, “downtown, not uptown.”
Rag & Bone.cities: Own stores in major metros · dept stores

Theory.name: Theory
Theory.why: Urban uniform tailoring; the Good Wool supply chain.
Theory.origin: Andrew Rosen and Elie Tahari, NYC, 1997 — the urban uniform in stretch wool.
Theory.opview: Positions itself as the urban uniform, solved.

notes.wool: the Good Wool traceable supply chain

marks: House fabric names: Precision Ponte, Good Linen (Good Wool elsewhere on site), Regal Wool, Moonsoft Cotton, Light Bilen, Neoteric Twill, Motion Wool / Motion Wool Twill / Motion Nylon / Motion Poplin, Relay Jersey, Anemone Modal Jersey, Cosmos Slub Cotton, Kelso Nylon, Pacific Linen, Plush Melton, S

James Perse.name: James Perse
James Perse.why: LA luxe basics — Supima jersey as a lifestyle.
James Perse.origin: Founded 1994 in LA by James Perse — son of Maxfield's founder, raised on the shop floor of California luxury.
James Perse.opview: Positions itself as Californian casual luxury — Supima as lifestyle.

onething.n: direct product page — style MLJ3311, the house names it without the word tee

notes.cotton: luxe Supima jersey as the whole brand

James Perse.cities: ~40 stores — LA, NYC & resort markets · Nordstrom

Vince.name: Vince
Vince.why: Boiled cashmere and quiet drape — contemporary comfort's reference house.
Vince.origin: LA, 2002 — contemporary comfort built on boiled cashmere and drape.

notes.cashmere: the boiled-cashmere funnel neck — structure as softness
notes.reach: thirty-eight stores, none of which publishes department data, so all thirty-eight are counted and flagged rather than assumed to carry menswear

marks: none (the only trademarked material name in the men's corpus, Acetate Renew™, is on stocked CHIMI eyewear - not Vince's)

Faherty.name: Faherty
Faherty.why: Family-run coastal comfort — the Bergdorf cashmere epiphany turned into eighty stores.
Faherty.origin: Twins Mike and Alex Faherty, 2013 — the brand Mike described in his college essay after a boyhood Bergdorf cashmere epiphany.
Faherty.opview: Mike Faherty, age 12, at Bergdorf: “I want my clothes to feel like this.”

notes.comfort: the Bergdorf cashmere epiphany, democratized into stretch flannel

Faherty.cities: 80+ stores — resort towns, golf clubs & metros · Concord MA (Blue Dry Goods)

Marine Layer.name: Marine Layer
Marine Layer.why: Absurdly soft signature knits, re-spun recycled cotton, neighborhood-store charm.
Marine Layer.origin: Mike Natenshon, SF, 2009 — started to recreate a favorite worn-out tee his girlfriend threw away.
Marine Layer.cities: 50+ cities coast to coast — own stores · Concord MA (Blue Dry Goods)
